color.summary: Geist is near-greyscale. Light pages are #fafafa with #fff cards, fields and menus, #171717 ink and #4d4d4d for secondary text. Dark pages are #000 with #0a0a0a surfaces, #ededed ink and #a1a1a1 secondary. Every hairline is one alpha grey: black at 8% in light (#ebebeb on white), white at 14% in dark. The main action is the ink itself, not a color. Blue (#0072f5) is kept for focus rings, switches and sliders; red #da2f35 and amber #ff990a for the error and warning buttons.
usage: Badges and Notes come in ten color scales, each as a solid and a subtle (tinted) pair.
The signed-in dashboard (Mehdi's 2026-10-22 local capture, not in this census) uses blue links at 400 and only subtle badges.

type.summary: Geist for all text and Geist Mono for code. Most UI is 14px on a 20px line at 400; buttons, badges and labels take 500. Headings are 600 with tight tracking: 24px on 32px at -0.96px, 20px on 26px at -0.4px. Some docs elements set GeistSans, an alias of the same font.

shape.summary: 6px corners on buttons, fields, selects and menu rows; 8px at the large size. Menus and modals round to 12px, tooltips 8px, keyboard keys 4px. Badges and the rounded buttons are pills.

spacing.summary: A 2px grid where 8px is the most common gap. Buttons and fields are 32, 36 or 40px (small, medium, large), with 6, 10 and 14px sides on buttons and 12px on fields. Menu rows are 36px with 8px padding inside a 6px inset.

elevation.summary: Mostly flat: surfaces are set apart by a 1px alpha ring drawn as a shadow, not a border. Menus add soft drops (0 1px 1px at 2%, 0 4px 8px -4px at 4%, 0 16px 24px -8px at 6%) and modals deeper ones (up to 0 32px 72px -12px). Focus is a 2px #0072f5 ring 2px outside; fields and selects use a grey focus border with a 3px halo instead.

button.summary: Five types share one shape: default (the ink), secondary (white in a hairline ring), tertiary (no fill), error and warning. All are 500 at 14px with 6px corners, in small (32px), medium (36px, the default) and large (40px, 16px text, 8px corners). Icon-only buttons are squares or circles from 24 to 40px. A disabled button of any type turns #f2f2f2 with #8f8f8f text.
